mentions.name: Personal website/blog with Eleventy
mentions.description: This is a personal website and blog built with Eleventy/11ty, chosen after comparing Jekyll, Hugo, and Eleventy. It showcases the author's work as part of a self-marketing effort during a job search.
mentions.problem: The author has been looking for a new role without much success and is using the site to market themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt: More generally, I'm working on setting up a personal website/blog. Did some research and after considering Jekyll, Hugo, and Eleventy/11ty, I'm going with the third.
